name: Midnight & Gold
note: Near-black navy against warm gold: a complementary pair (blue vs yellow-orange). Gold is kept for what matters; the cool blue is the quiet second voice.

name: Graphite & Cyan
note: Neutral greys with one vivid cyan, plus a violet split-complement used sparingly: a cockpit-display feel.

name: Forest & Coral
note: Deep green-teal against coral: the complementary pair from the laptop's knot logo, with mint as a gentle neighbour.

name: Atlas Indigo
note: The original Atlas look, calmer: ink indigo with a soft violet and a sky-blue neighbour, amber as the one warm call.
